summary: Retain combined-bilateral-section-handles-v7 (3b606292-c3c6-4266-bcfd-7bdaf5788d19) as an unqualified bilateral-shoulder diagnostic only. Proximal-arm cross-section translation applied symmetrically to both UpperArmL and UpperArmR (0.01805H displacement) with coherent medial chest displacement (0.00349H at 60 degrees, 0 at 90 degrees) within the frozen 0.02H shoulder cap resolves high contact counts across both shoulders: left straight 60° (348 -> 23), left straight 90° (93 -> 0), right straight 60° (390 -> 44), right straight 90° (166 -> 0), left compound twists 60/elbow60/twist -20, 0, +20 (363->24, 364->38, 396->97), right compound twists (443->134, 414->69, 386->40), and compound 90/elbow90/twist0 (Left 107->0, Right 178->0). Both straight 90° and compound 90° poses on BOTH arms reach ZERO contacts, with zero contact regressions across all 25 evaluation poses. Extending the distal humerus envelope smoothly across [0.0, 0.25, 0.55, 0.95] completely eliminates the horizontal deltoid-biceps transition dent observed in v6 (61a07eaa). Bilateral morph normal delta transport (UpperArmL_60, UpperArmL_90, UpperArmR_60, UpperArmR_90) eliminates active support normal divergence on training poses from max 58.5°-82.7° to 0.000002°-0.000018° (worse > 1°: 0) while passing Khronos gltf-validator with 0 errors and verifying Babylon shader defines (BONETEXTURE, MORPHTARGETS_NORMAL, NUM_BONE_INFLUENCERS 8, NONUNIFORMSCALING absent). However, Babylon visual review confirms that hip creases remain at baseline (42 contacts at 90/knee90/twist+20; 17 at twist+10), and anterior axillary crease compression persists at 60°.

companion_normal_transport.summary: Pre-skin morph normal delta transport on all four bilateral shoulder targets (UpperArmL_60, UpperArmL_90, UpperArmR_60, UpperArmR_90) reduces active support normal divergence on training poses from max 58.5°-82.7° to 0.000002°-0.000018° with 0 support vertices worse over 1°, reduces p90 normal error on all compound right shoulder poses to < 0.006° and compound left poses to < 0.22°, passes gltf-validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 with 0 errors, and confirms Babylon shader compilation with MORPHTARGETS_NORMAL, BONETEXTURE, NUM_BONE_INFLUENCERS 8, and NONUNIFORMSCALING absent.

limitations: Twenty-four contour captures and four normal-corrected captures inspected directly, out of 150+18 captures.
Front camera at UpperArm 90 degrees looks down the forward-raised forearm and partially occludes the anterior shoulder root; oblique and side views expose the deltoid and axillary transition.
Smooth envelope across [0.0, 0.25, 0.55, 0.95] eliminates the horizontal transition dent, but anterior axillary skin compression persists at 60 degrees under the armpit.

Hips remain at baseline: ThighL 90/knee90/twist+20 (42 contacts) and twist+10 (17 contacts) show visible creases; proximal thigh section handle produced 0 contact change and was excluded from normal transport due to split crease normals.
Khronos gltf-validator reports 0 errors and 1 NODE_SKINNED_MESH_NON_ROOT warning on contour-diagnostic.glb (plus 4 BUFFER_VIEW_TARGET_MISSING hints and 4 UNUSED_OBJECT infos on normal-corrected.glb).
No game clips, outfit fitting, production 8-influence admission, or avatar publication is claimed.
